Class Revision Worksheets & Exercise Answers

Lesson 1: The Handmade Flag
Date: 7-8-26 (Friday)

I. FILL UP
1. We celebrate republic day on 26th January.
2. We celebrate independence day on 15 August.
3. An ashoka chakra has 24 spokes.
4. Saffron colour in the flag indicates the strength and courage.
5. The white colour shows peace and truth.

Activity 3: Draw and colour our national flag

II. TRUE OR FALSE
1. Noni and her friends made a national flag to gift to their school. — True
2. Sarbjeet got poster paints. — True
3. Laila brought coloured marker pens. — False
4. The green colour shows the growth and prosperity. — True

III. ANSWER THE FOLLOWING
1. What was Noni's idea for the Republic Day celebration?
Ans: To make a hand-made flag.
2. Who praised their handmade flag in school?
Ans: The principal praised them.

Lesson 2: On the Breakfast Table
Date: 18-9-26 / 7-10-26 (Wednesday)

I. TRUE OR FALSE
1. Ria sit in front of the TV. — False
2. Ria asks for more chutney politely. — True
3. Ankita burps loudly. — True
4. Ria goes to wash her hands. — True
5. Ankita talks with her mouth full of dosa. — True

II. MATCH THE FOLLOWING
Prompt / Action | Matching Etiquette
1. Starting the meal | with a prayer
2. Waiting until | everyone is served
3. Chewing | Mouth closed
4. Use | Cutlery and napkin

III. ANSWER THE FOLLOWING
1. What did Ria's mom make for the girls?
Ans: Ria's mom make dosas and chutney.
2. Why did Anika thank Ria's mom?
Ans: Because Ria's mom gave more chutney.
